name: French Chicken Fricassee
method: braise (sear then braise with lid on stovetop)
note: Classic French white-wine cream braise finished with egg-yolk liaison, tarragon and nutmeg, no starch base. Distinct from catalog neighbors: slow-cooker-creamy-chicken-and-mushroom-bowls (American rice bowl, different method+starch), coq-au-vin (red-wine braise), chicken-normandy (cider-apple cream), chicken-florentine (spinach, no mushroom). 14g carbs, strong low-carb fit; widens the French cuisine spread. Cross-lane check vs accepted-slugs: no twin. CROSS-PROTEIN WATCH: a turkey or pork white-wine creamy-mushroom fricassee braise would be the same dinner under another protein - reject such a twin against this acceptance if it reaches me.
